Who We Are

A nationally experienced operator, built for growth.

Priority Life Care is a nationally experienced operator with a track record of revenue and NOI growth. From middle-market to high-end private-pay Independent Living, Assisted Living, and Memory Care communities, PLC works alongside residents to achieve the outcomes they want.

We offer the highest quality of amenities and services — giving residents the right choices for overall wellness and independence.

Where We Are

65 Communities. 12 States. One Mission.

At Priority Life Care, we believe everyone deserves dignity, compassion, and respect. Our communities are built around that belief — a safe, maintenance-free place to live so residents can pursue their hobbies and enjoy their retirement years.

How It Started

In 2009, the Petras family founded Priority Life Care to offer senior living for all financial backgrounds.

Sevy and Bobby Petras pioneered assisted living and memory care options that were rare at the time. Their motto: "Lighting the Way in Senior Care." Today, PLC serves over 5,000 residents, continuing that mission.

2009
Lamp Light turnaround portfolio in Fort Wayne, IN gives way to the birth of Priority Life Care. Expanded reach initially through managed communities with capital partners spanning Medicaid, middle market, private pay, and new development lease-ups.
2021
Awarded 17 managed communities with Ventas on a turnaround portfolio. PLC's performance led to additional growth — 32 properties managed for Ventas today.
2023
Launched back-office services support for Accounting, Finance, and Facilities management to other operators.
2024
Grown to over 65 managed communities. Given the profitability of the management company, PLC is seizing the current real-estate cycle by launching a fund and growing new Joint Ventures.

Mission

To compassionately light the way in senior care, with respect, to affordability and independence.

Technology & Data

A modern data platform, built for the frontier of senior living.

PLC has unified operational data from across the entire portfolio into a single data lake — occupancy, financials, staffing, and clinical signals, all in one place. Power BI turns it into a live, portfolio-wide picture. An AI layer sits on top of both, so leadership can ask questions in plain language and get straight answers from the company's own data — not another static report to dig through.

01

Unified Data Lake

Every community's operational data — census, financials, staffing, clinical — flows into one source of truth, reconciled against Yardi.

02

Power BI, Portfolio-Wide

Live dashboards replace static monthly reports, giving every level of the organization the same real-time picture.

03

AI Layered on Top

Leadership can have a direct conversation with the company's own data — asking questions and surfacing what actually needs attention, in seconds.

Point Solutions Across the Portfolio

Core Platform

SkyPoint

PLC's centralized data and AI platform — unifying operational data across the portfolio into a single data lake, layered with Power BI and an AI layer that lets leadership have direct conversations with the company's own data.

Safely You

A dedicated strategic partner focused on fall detection and prevention — resulting in fewer resident falls (40%) and fewer trips to the ER (80%).

Core Platform

ECP

PLC's electronic health record and eMAR platform — the clinical backbone behind care documentation and medication administration in every community.

Yardi

PLC's financial system of record — the general ledger and property management platform underlying the books for every community in the portfolio.

Case Studies

Numbers, not adjectives.

Five portfolios. Five different situations — a turnaround, a lease-up, a joint venture. The same disciplined playbook every time.

Case Study 01

Northeast 17 Portfolio

17 communities · Pennsylvania & West Virginia

+$12.5M NOI growth

Awarded management in December 2021 on a portfolio 20–40+ years old and in need of a capex refresh. Eliminated $2.4M in agency staffing, drove a 20% occupancy increase, and grew NOI from $1.3M to $13.8M.
